description: WebGL unmasked vendor and renderer identity, drawn only from measured members of the resolved anchor. Identity rotation is measured-safe inside an anchor because its members agree on every capability digest; it is never valid across anchors, which is the failure the retired family catalogue shipped (docs/FINGERPRINTS.md sections 1 and 4).
label: gpu_identity

options.note: Measured identity strings for NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER on anchor linux-vulkan-nvidia-adf287b8f0ee (Linux / ANGLE/Vulkan). Rotation inside this anchor is measured-safe: every member produced the same WebGL1 and WebGL2 capability digests and the same readback render digest. Measured on Chromium 152.0.7977.82 against release pin 152.0.7977.83: same major, different patch. Version-bearing fields will differ from a pinned-build reference and a V3 run must report that separately.
